Computer Engineering · Rochester Institute of Technology

I’m a computer engineering student at RIT, graduating in May 2028. My main interests are robotics, computer vision, and embedded systems.

My projects focus on perception and control: comparing vision methods, connecting them to robot behavior, and measuring where they work and where they fail. I’m seeking internships in robotics and computer vision.

Projects

Webots Neural Vision Robot

Compared a small CNN with calibrated HSV tracking for an e-puck robot in Webots. The robot follows a selected red, blue, or green target using camera frames and proximity sensors.

Evaluated on 3,600 synthetic images and 108 paired simulation trials.

Python / PyTorch / OpenCV / Webots

Pan/Tilt Camera Tracking Simulation

Built a two-axis camera tracking simulation in MuJoCo, connecting day/night vision models, a Kalman tracker, and a controller that centers moving drone geometry.

Nominal simulation: 44.40 → 2.04 px mean centering error.

Python / PyTorch / MuJoCo / C

Project detailsCodeVideo

Flesh and Blood Life Tracker

Designed an ESP32-S3 life and resource counter with a custom 70 × 80 mm PCB, debounced inputs, undo, and multiplexed display output.

Host-tested state logic; full assembled-board testing remains.

C++ / ESP-IDF / FreeRTOS / KiCad
